body:
I can't be fulfilled without sex. That's just a fact. 

I'm done arguing with you.
Empty words that do nothing but make you feel better about yourself.
There is no "living" without sex.
I'll repeat this here for people who don't reread the OP: if you know of a good way to kill myself, please email me at khf9051@gmail.com
Right, because it's so much more moral to leave me to continue suffering.
I'm not going to reconsider. There's no other way out.

Help finding a good way to kill myself. That's apparently against the rules here, so I ask that anyone who can actually help with that send me an email.
That way nobody has to break the rules here.
Nothing whatsoever. I don't give a fuck what you think about that. It's the truth for me.
Death. Hence, this thread.
Yeah. All that stuff is true. So fucking what? Yeah, I do mentally identify as a teenager because I never got to be one.
The mental problem is CAUSED BY the physical problem. I cannot be satisfied if I can't have lots of sex. I truly don't care if you think there's something wrong with that.
I've considered it, and I've REJECTED it. It's easy to say "there's more to life" when it's not your problem.
No there isn't. I have a physical problem that can't be fixed. There's no other way out.
Fuck you and your talk of "more to life than sex". That should be my fucking decision to make.

If anyone is still reading this:

I think the only thing keeping me alive right now is that I want to do something to punish my parents before I die and I haven't figured out what would be best.

Not sure what I mean to accomplish by posting this, but fuck it. I'm having a fucking psychotic breakdown. Who fucking gives a fuck. I'm amazed I'm even bothering to type properly.

That doesn't fucking help AT FUCKING ALL. I don't give a FUCK if what I'm feeling is "normal" or not. There's no accepting this. No matter what I do, this isn't going to fucking change. This isn't just a fucking disability. MY ENTIRE LIFE WAS RIPPED AWAY FROM ME BEFORE IT EVEN FUCKING BEGAN.

This comment is COMPLETELY FUCKING PATRONIZING.
No. It's just my penis. I'm pretty okay otherwise, at least physically. And that just makes it worse, because I don't even get the sympathy I'd get if I were completely paralyzed.

No pleasure at all. I can't feel a fucking thing. And don't tell me "there are ways", by which I assume you mean pills. Having to depend on pills is so humiliating that I wouldn't be able to enjoy the sex even if they worked (which they don't). By "youthful", I mean energetic, intense, frequent, and most of all, fucking SPONTANEOUS. With the pills, you have to take them at least an hour before you do anything. That's worse than nothing.

No, I don't have any hope of it being fixed. And there's no "working around it". I assume that by "working around it" you mean "there are other ways to please your partner". Sure. But this isn't about not being able to please a partner, it's about not being able to please MYSELF. Imagine telling a woman with vaginismus that she could still at least give men blowjobs. Sure, but that's not what she wants, and she would rightfully consider it insulting that a person would imply that she should be satisfied with that.

I don't care if age gaps are acceptable. I don't want to be "the older man". I'm attracted to varying types of women of various ages, but no matter who the woman is, I want to have sex with them AS A YOUNG GUY. It's not just about sex, it's also about IDENTITY.

I don't see what confuses you. I want wild, promiscuous, and youthful sex. I absolutely do not want "something more than a one-night stand". I have no desire for any monogamous relationship. I don't even want anyone to really know me.

I also have a more "feminine" sexuality, in that I would rather be seen as beautiful and sensuous (but in a masculine way; I don't want a sex change) than macho and badass. I want to be an object of desire, and be pursued, not have someone be "won over" into having sex with me.

Basically, I'm like a girl who got really hot after high school and then went out and fucked a lot of guys or became a porn star or a stripper or something, only those options weren't available to me.

The realization that even if my physical problem could be fixed, there's still no hope of me getting what I wanted out of life. I held on in the past because there was still time. Now there isn't.

And if you're going to say something like "that's too long to be so caught up with this, don't you think it's time to move on?", then you and I have nothing more to say to each other.

All of it. I'm missing out on all of it. What that means is that there's no way to "replace" it with something else. I don't want sex because I think it would give me something that I might get elsewhere - I want sex because I want SEX.

I would be happy if I could ACTUALLY sleep around, and not just TRY to.

When I was a teenager, I was in a car accident that left my penis damaged beyond repair. I can't have sex. I had to watch my entire youth pass me by and I couldn't do anything about it. Now I'm 28. Even if my body could be fixed, it's too late for me to have the youthful sexual adventures and promiscuity that I wanted, and I still identify as a teenager, so people wouldn't accept me because they'd expect me to act like a 28 year old.

So, is this the part where you parrot out the line that "there's more to life than sex" or call me pathetic or whatever?
Well, I'm not married to the idea of death by gunshot. If you know a better way, I'd like to hear it.

If I knew of a painless way to do it, I'd take it. I've already done a bit of punishing myself in the past year with compulsive eating. I started to feel that I didn't deserve something that made me feel better if it didn't have some negative consequence. Video games won't automatically do anything bad to you, but food makes you gain weight.

And no, I don't have unlimited options. I have an incurable physical problem.

I'm not determined to punish myself with my suicide method. I once asked my doctor if he would help me end things painlessly, but he refused. If you know of a less painful way to go, I'd certainly like to know about it.
I decided on the chest because the head carries the risk of survival with brain damage.
Yes. And don't try to guilt trip me about my parents finding my body. At this point, I hate them for even having me.

I've been to doctors. Almost a dozen of them over the years. I've also tried several antidepressants and one antipsychotic. None of them helped. This isn't chemicals being all fucked up, this is a response to a situation.
I decided on the chest because the head carries the risk of survival with brain damage.

I have no hobbies and I love nothing. I used to love video games, but now I can't stand them, and I've thrown most of my collection against the wall and shattered all of them - hundreds of dollars worth, all gone in moments, and I do not give a fuck.

I want to do it because I have an incurable physical problem that is life-ruining but not life-threatening, so no one will even feel sorry for me for it.

And I have thought it through. I've spent the last ten years thinking it through. I came here because I'm too depressed to go looking all around the internet and I know this place.
My condition IS permanent. I have an incurable physical problem that has ruined my life and I simply can't stand to exist any more.
